prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas, FOUR hammer-gripping right hands for an existing cute knight game. The attached two images are STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCES only: image1 defines silver-blue plate gauntlet thickness and drawing style, image2 defines the brown wrapped wooden hammer shaft. Do not reproduce either reference sheet.
Exactly FOUR separate close-up hand sprites in a 2-column by 2-row grid on a transparent 1024x1024 PNG. Big transparent gutters, consistent hand scale. No body, no arm beyond a short wrist cuff, no hammer head, no sword, no captions or shadows.
CRITICAL GRIP: each closed fist firmly wraps around a SHORT STRAIGHT VERTICAL brown spiral-wrapped wooden SHAFT. The shaft runs UP/DOWN through the palm BETWEEN curled fingers and thumb, never out of the front knuckles. About 1/3 of the palm thickness for the shaft diameter. Show some wood above the thumb and below the little finger, so the axial grip is obvious. Shaft stays perfectly vertical in every sprite. Thumb is on the UPPER end, the end towards the future hammer head. Realistic grasp anatomy adapted to chunky cute cartoon proportions.
ALL FOUR have the cuff/wrist opening to IMAGE RIGHT, fist/knuckles towards IMAGE LEFT, shaft on the LEFT HALF of the fist. The game will mirror each whole hand when needed. Keep wrist centered horizontally behind palm, not attached to an upper corner. A normal human right hand, one thumb and four curled fingers, NO extra finger/floating glove. Preserve thick stocky hand and broad cuff proportions matching reference. No thin adult hands.
TOP LEFT: matching SILVER-BLUE armored right gauntlet, near-camera three-quarter view, clearly see rounded closed finger plates and the thumb wrapping over the shaft; cuff connects naturally on image-right.
TOP RIGHT: the SAME SILVER-BLUE armored right hand and same grip, viewed from the opposite/far side of the hand (more palm/thumb side), same cuff on image-right, shaft vertical, thumb at upper/head end. Do not just draw a second identical fist.
BOTTOM LEFT: same near-side grip but a chunky warm BROWN LEATHER glove and simple leather cuff for the unarmored hammer trainer; no metal armor.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same far-side palm/thumb-side grip with matching BROWN LEATHER glove/cuff, no metal.
Make the short wood shaft continuous, visible emerging above and below the gripping hand. Its central portion is occluded by the curved fingers. No pommel, hammer head, gold ornament or pointed tool. Genuine transparent background and clear complete silhouettes.
